summary: First-finish smoke test of DoCA e-Procurement portal. Backend smoke (crops=8, mandis=12, admin+farmer login) OK. Frontend end-to-end flows covered: landing load, language switcher (EN/HI/PA via Radix combobox), farmer login -> /dashboard, book slot 3-step (Wheat -> Khanna mandi -> date/qty/time -> confirm -> /bookings), My Bookings render, registration with simulated OTP visible on screen -> verify -> auto-login to /dashboard, admin login -> Procurement Command Center rows, and complete admin lifecycle: Start (booked->in_process) -> Complete (weight/grade/price) -> Initiate DBT Payment (payment_ref DBTxxxxxx generated, status=paid). Punjabi labels render correctly in navbar and stat cards after switch.
passed: Landing page loads with hero and navbar
Language switcher EN/HI/PA works (Devanagari and Gurmukhi chars rendered)
Book slot flow: crop -> mandi (mandi-pb-khn-01 Khanna) -> date/time/qty -> confirm -> /bookings with token
My Bookings page shows bookings list
Register: send-otp returns simulated OTP shown via data-testid=otp-code, verify redirects to /dashboard (auto-login)
Admin login -> /admin shows stat cards + bookings rows
Admin Start -> Complete (weight 9.5, grade, price 2275) -> Initiate DBT Payment; booking status becomes 'paid' with DBT ref visible in row
